title: Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Marketing Communication
description: The aim of this course is to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of the role and importance of marketing communication in the success of a business.
longDescription: Marketing Communications. The Role Of Marketing Communication. The Marketing Communications Mix. Effectiveness Of The Promotional Tools. Management Of The Promotional Tools. Word-Of-Mouth Communications. Branding. Process Of Diffusion. Framework for analyzing marketing communication process. The aim of this course is to provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of the role and importance of marketing communication in the success of a business. Through this course, learners will develop a fundamental understanding of the principles and techniques involved in effective marketing communication and its various components. They will also gain practical experience in planning and executing marketing communication campaigns. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: Introduction to Marketing Communication is a foundational course that provides an overview of the various elements that make up the marketing communication mix. It covers advertising, public relations, sales promotion, personal selling, direct marketing, and digital marketing, among other topics.
